description: This file defines the FooTable.Sorting component, which adds sorting functionality to table columns, including initialization, UI updates, sorting logic, and event handling.

classes.name: FooTable.Sorting
classes.description: A component that adds sorting capabilities to table columns, including UI controls, sorting logic, and event management.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sorting component, setting up references and default states.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and configures the sorting component based on provided data and options before UI creation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the sorting UI, binds event handlers, and records initial sort state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes UI elements and event handlers related to sorting, cleaning up the component.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Performs sorting of table rows based on the current sorted column and direction.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates the sorting UI indicators to reflect the current sorted column and direction.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets sorting options and triggers table redraw to apply sorting.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the sorting state has changed from the initial configuration.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the table sorting to its initial state.

methods.name: _sort
methods.description: Handles the sorting process, raising events before and after sorting is applied.

methods.name: _onSortClicked
methods.description: Event handler for user clicking on a sortable column header to trigger sorting.
